product_one_liner.value: Disprz is an AI-powered learning and skilling platform that helps enterprises train, onboard and upskill their knowledge workers and frontline employees.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains learning-and-development, product and marketing articles; no qualifying engineer-authored series explaining how the product is built was found.

public_docs.notes: Public external API documentation and a public technical/security knowledge base are available.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: An AI Engineer vacancy is publicly listed with applicant messaging. Another recruitment site marks a matching role closed, so whether the underlying vacancy is still accepting applications is not independently confirmed.

model_provider.notes: Microsoft’s customer story explicitly identifies Azure OpenAI for learning-material personalization and quotes Disprz’s co-founder; no particular model version is specified.

compliance_certs.notes: Disprz claims SOC 2 Type 1 and Type 2, ISO 27001:2013, and certification as GDPR compliant; HIPAA and PCI DSS are described as not applicable.

last_funding.notes: Date is the official announcement month. PitchBook lists the transaction in July 2023. A September 2025 article repeats the earlier pre-Series-C bridge-round announcement; the same round was reported in January 2023, so it is not treated as a new round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round predates the 2025-05-09 to 2026-11-09 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A Senior Business Development Representative vacancy is publicly listed on an investor job board; the readable posting does not display a closure notice.

launched_6mo.notes: Disprz announced Autonomous Enablement OS on 2026-09-28, inside the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Anand Venkatesan’s profile lists Senior Vice President & Head of Engineering at Disprz from March 2026, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The business-development job posting names these tools as preferred familiarity for managing leads and tracking progress; this is a hiring-stack signal, not independent confirmation of deployment.
